MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The step drill bits feel like a natural next purchase because making and enlarging holes supports the rivets and rivet nuts I have been buying.",
    "The machine screws and stainless fasteners fit my ongoing interest in assembling and securing parts, even when I do not need those exact sizes immediately."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Printer filament assumes I have a printing project or printer, neither of which is suggested by my recent purchases.",
    "The jewelry cleaner and brad nails serve different tasks from my current bolted and riveted assemblies; being useful equipment does not make them useful to me now.",
    "Specific screw lengths and half-inch washers require matching project dimensions, so their general relevance does not give me a reason to buy them today."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My interest in hands-on projects seems to have been stretched into an assumed need for 3D printing supplies.",
    "My fastener purchases seem to have been treated as a reason to suggest more fasteners without enough attention to fit or what my existing assortments already cover."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "Tools that help me use my recent supplies matter more right now than additional packs of similar hardware; the step bits fill a practical role alongside my riveting equipment.",
    "Exact dimensions, thread compatibility and intended material determine whether a fastener is useful, and ambiguous metric-versus-UNC wording makes me hesitate.",
    "My recent purchases suggest fastening and fabrication tasks, but they do not establish ownership of a 3D printer or brad nailer."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognize my fastening and fabrication interests, but sometimes confuse broad workshop relevance with a practical next need."
}
